body:
## Summary

Dates of birth are detected only with a structured key such as `dob: ...`. Natural-language and loosely labelled birth dates pass through. A real leak included remarks like "real DOB `02/03/1990`".

## Reproduction (synthetic data)

```js
const s = createSanitizer();
for (const t of [
  'she was born on 07/12/1985 in Kazan',
  'All correct - real DOB `02/03/1990`',
  'birth date 1985-12-07',
]) console.log((await s.sanitize(t)).text);
// None are redacted. 'Дата рождения: 07.12.1985' is detected, so the gap is label coverage, not date parsing.
```

## Expected

- `DATE_OF_BIRTH` when birth vocabulary (born, birth date, DOB, дата рождения, д.р., родился/родилась, Geburtsdatum, fecha de nacimiento, date de naissance) appears within a short window before a date, including markdown/backtick quoting.
- All common date shapes: `dd/mm/yyyy`, `mm/dd/yyyy`, `dd.mm.yyyy`, ISO, and month names in English and Russian.
- Keep plain dates (commit dates, timestamps) untouched without birth context.
title: Detect dates of birth in natural language and loose labels
